_comment: Buyer-facing factual descriptions for the pharma catalogue, keyed by product id. Merged by scripts/import_products.py after the sheet and the other side files. Each entry states what the substance is and its established use from public pharmacological and chemical references; none claims a Jaydev grade, DMF/CEP/GMP status, supplier or capacity. Three entries deliberately have no description because their catalogue CAS conflicts with public reference data (erbium-hydroxide, methyl-2-2-difluoro-2-fluorosulfonyl-acetate, 3-3-3-trifluoro-2-2-dimethylpropionic-acid); those pages show catalogue identity only.
5-ala-5-aminolevulinic-acid-hydrochlorid: 5-Aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (5-ALA) is a naturally occurring amino acid derivative used in photodynamic diagnosis and therapy, including tumour visualisation during glioma surgery.
abemaciclib: Abemaciclib is a selective CDK4/6 inhibitor used for HR-positive, HER2-negative early and metastatic breast cancer, alone or in combination with endocrine therapy.
acyclovir: Acyclovir is a nucleoside analogue antiviral active against herpes viruses. It is formulated into oral, topical and intravenous products for herpes simplex and varicella-zoster infections, including cold sores, genital herpes, shingles and chickenpox.
allopurinol: Allopurinol is a xanthine oxidase inhibitor that lowers uric acid production. It is used for gout and to prevent hyperuricaemia during cancer chemotherapy.
amlexanox: Amlexanox is an anti-inflammatory, anti-allergic agent used mainly as a topical treatment for recurrent aphthous (mouth) ulcers.
azithromycin: Azithromycin is a broad-spectrum macrolide antibiotic used for respiratory tract, ear, skin and certain sexually transmitted infections.
benazepril-hcl: Benazepril hydrochloride is an ACE inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure and heart failure, alone or in fixed combinations with amlodipine or hydrochlorothiazide.
budesonide: Budesonide is a glucocorticoid used in inhaled and nasal forms for asthma and allergic rhinitis, and in oral and rectal forms for inflammatory bowel disease.
cagrilintide: Cagrilintide is a long-acting amylin analogue developed for weight management, studied alone and in combination with semaglutide.
calcipotriol-monohydrate: Calcipotriol (calcipotriene) monohydrate is a vitamin D3 analogue used topically for plaque psoriasis, where it slows the overproduction of skin cells.
calcium-folinate: Calcium folinate (folinic acid, leucovorin) is a reduced folate used to reduce methotrexate toxicity and in combination with 5-fluorouracil in colorectal cancer chemotherapy.
cetrorelix-acetate: Cetrorelix acetate is a GnRH antagonist used in assisted reproduction to prevent premature ovulation during controlled ovarian stimulation.
clindamycin-palmitate-hydrochloride: Clindamycin palmitate hydrochloride is the oral-suspension prodrug form of clindamycin, a lincosamide antibiotic used for anaerobic and Gram-positive infections.
clindamycin-phosphate: Clindamycin phosphate is the water-soluble prodrug of clindamycin used in injectable and topical formulations for anaerobic, skin and acne-related infections.
clobetasol-propionate: Clobetasol propionate is a highly potent topical corticosteroid used for severe inflammatory skin conditions such as psoriasis and eczema.
d-serine: D-serine is a neuromodulator amino acid that acts as a co-agonist at the NMDA receptor glycine site. It is used in central nervous system research.
darolutamide: Darolutamide is an androgen receptor inhibitor used for non-metastatic castration-resistant and metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
dexmedetomidine-hydrochloride: Dexmedetomidine hydrochloride is a selective alpha-2 adrenergic agonist used for sedation in intensive care and procedural settings.
diclofenac-sodium: Diclofenac sodium is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) formulated into oral, topical and injectable products for pain and inflammation.
enoxaparin-sodium: Enoxaparin sodium is a low-molecular-weight heparin used to prevent and treat deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism, and in the management of acute coronary syndromes.
entecavir-monohydrate: Entecavir monohydrate is a nucleoside analogue antiviral used for chronic hepatitis B infection.
fenofibrate: Fenofibrate is a fibrate that lowers triglycerides and LDL cholesterol while raising HDL cholesterol, used in the treatment of mixed dyslipidaemia and hypertriglyceridaemia.
fludarabine-phosphate: Fludarabine phosphate is a purine analogue chemotherapy agent used mainly for chronic lymphocytic leukaemia and in conditioning regimens before stem cell transplant.
fluvastatin-sodium: Fluvastatin sodium is a statin used to lower LDL cholesterol in hypercholesterolaemia.
folcisteine: Folcisteine is a mucolytic agent that thins and clears viscous mucus, used in respiratory conditions with difficult secretions.
gemcitabine: Gemcitabine is a nucleoside analogue chemotherapy used for pancreatic, lung, breast, bladder and ovarian cancers, supplied as the hydrochloride salt for injection.
hcg: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) is a gonadotrophic hormone used in fertility treatment to trigger ovulation and to support testosterone production in male hypogonadism.
heparin-sodium: Heparin sodium is a fast-acting injectable anticoagulant used for the prevention and treatment of thrombosis, during dialysis, and in cardiovascular surgery.
hmg: Human menopausal gonadotropin (hMG, menotropin) is a purified preparation of FSH and LH used in assisted reproduction to stimulate the development of multiple ovarian follicles.
hydroxyethyl-starch-130-0-4: Hydroxyethyl starch 130/0.4 is a colloid used as a plasma volume expander in fluid therapy.
icodextrin: Icodextrin is a glucose polymer used as the osmotic agent in peritoneal dialysis solutions.
indometacin: Indometacin (indomethacin) is a potent NSAID used for gout, ankylosing spondylitis and other inflammatory joint conditions, with specialist uses including patent ductus arteriosus closure in neonates.
lactulose: Lactulose is a synthetic disaccharide used as an osmotic laxative for constipation and to lower blood ammonia in hepatic encephalopathy.
lemborexant: Lemborexant is a dual orexin receptor antagonist used for the treatment of insomnia, helping both sleep onset and sleep maintenance.
letermovir: Letermovir is a cytomegalovirus (CMV) terminase inhibitor used to prevent CMV infection and disease in transplant recipients.
levofloxacin-hemihydrate: Levofloxacin hemihydrate is a broad-spectrum fluoroquinolone antibiotic used for respiratory, urinary tract, skin and other bacterial infections.
loxoprofen-sodium: Loxoprofen sodium is a propionic acid NSAID prodrug used for pain and inflammation.
lumateperone-tosylate: Lumateperone tosylate is an atypical antipsychotic acting across dopamine, serotonin and glutamate pathways, used for schizophrenia and bipolar depression.
maribavir: Maribavir is a CMV pUL97 kinase inhibitor used for post-transplant cytomegalovirus infection that is refractory or resistant to earlier antivirals.
mepivacaine-hydrochloride: Mepivacaine hydrochloride is an amide local anaesthetic used in dentistry and minor surgical procedures.
mesalamine: Mesalamine (5-aminosalicylic acid) is an anti-inflammatory used orally and rectally to induce and maintain remission in ulcerative colitis.
mupirocin: Mupirocin is a topical antibiotic used for impetigo and infected skin lesions, and for nasal decolonisation of MRSA.
mycophenolate-mofetil: Mycophenolate mofetil is an immunosuppressant prodrug used to prevent organ rejection after kidney, heart or liver transplant, and in autoimmune disease.
n-acetyl-l-cysteine: N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) is a mucolytic used as an antidote for paracetamol (acetaminophen) overdose, and as a glutathione precursor in respiratory and liver applications.
naldemedine: Naldemedine is a peripherally acting mu-opioid receptor antagonist used for opioid-induced constipation.
neomycin-sulfate: Neomycin sulfate is an aminoglycoside antibiotic used topically for skin and eye infections and orally for hepatic encephalopathy.
nitrofurantoin: Nitrofurantoin is a urinary antibiotic used for uncomplicated urinary tract infections.
olaparib: Olaparib is a PARP inhibitor used in ovarian, breast, prostate and pancreatic cancers carrying BRCA or homologous-recombination repair mutations.
oseltamivir-phosphate: Oseltamivir phosphate is a neuraminidase inhibitor used for the treatment and prevention of influenza A and B.
oxybuprocaine-hydrochloride: Oxybuprocaine hydrochloride (benoxinate) is a fast-acting topical anaesthetic used in ophthalmology for tonometry and short procedures.
paclitaxel: Paclitaxel is a taxane chemotherapy originally derived from yew-tree chemistry, used in ovarian, breast, lung and other solid tumours.
piroxicam: Piroxicam is an oxicam NSAID used for rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and other inflammatory pain.
posaconazole: Posaconazole is a broad-spectrum triazole antifungal used to treat and prevent invasive Aspergillus and Candida infections in high-risk patients.
prednisolone: Prednisolone is a glucocorticoid used across inflammatory, allergic, autoimmune and respiratory conditions, formulated as oral, injectable, ophthalmic and rectal products.
promethazine-hydrochloride: Promethazine hydrochloride is a first-generation antihistamine used for allergy, nausea and motion sickness, and as a sedative.
propofol: Propofol is a short-acting intravenous anaesthetic used for induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia and for sedation.
regorafenib: Regorafenib is an oral multi-kinase inhibitor used in metastatic colorectal cancer, gastrointestinal stromal tumours and hepatocellular carcinoma.
resmetirom: Resmetirom is a thyroid hormone receptor beta agonist used for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) with liver fibrosis.
retatrutide: Retatrutide is a triple GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist developed for obesity and type 2 diabetes.
sacubitril-sodium: Sacubitril sodium is a neprilysin inhibitor used in fixed combination with valsartan for chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
samidorphan-l-malate: Samidorphan L-malate is an opioid receptor antagonist used in fixed combination with olanzapine.
sertraline-hydrochloride: Sertraline hydrochloride is an SSRI antidepressant used for depression, anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder, PTSD and panic disorder.
simvastatin: Simvastatin is a statin used to lower LDL cholesterol.
sulbactam-pivoxil: Sulbactam pivoxil is an orally absorbed beta-lactamase inhibitor prodrug, combined with ampicillin or other beta-lactams to overcome resistant bacteria.
suzetrigine: Suzetrigine is a selective NaV1.8 sodium-channel blocker, a non-opioid oral analgesic for moderate to severe acute pain.
teprenone: Teprenone (geranylgeranylacetone) is a gastric mucosal protectant used in the treatment of gastritis and gastric ulcers.
tigecycline: Tigecycline is a glycylcycline antibiotic used for complicated skin, intra-abdominal and other serious infections caused by multidrug-resistant bacteria.
tirzepatide: Tirzepatide is a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist used for type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management.
tranexamic-acid: Tranexamic acid is an antifibrinolytic used to prevent and treat bleeding in surgery, trauma, heavy menstrual bleeding and dental procedures.
ursodeoxycholic-acid: Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) is a bile acid used to dissolve cholesterol gallstones and to treat primary biliary cholangitis and other cholestatic liver conditions.
vinorelbine-tartrate: Vinorelbine tartrate is a semi-synthetic vinca alkaloid used in non-small cell lung cancer and metastatic breast cancer.
afoxolaner: Afoxolaner is an isoxazoline ectoparasiticide used in dogs against flea and tick infestations, given orally.
flunixin-meglumine: Flunixin meglumine is an NSAID used in veterinary medicine for pain, inflammation and fever, including equine colic and musculoskeletal pain.
fluralaner: Fluralaner is a long-acting isoxazoline ectoparasiticide used in dogs and cats against fleas and ticks, formulated as chewable tablets and topical solutions.
marbofloxacin: Marbofloxacin is a veterinary fluoroquinolone antibiotic used in dogs, cats and livestock for respiratory, skin and urinary tract infections.
maropitant-citrate-hydrate: Maropitant citrate is an NK1 receptor antagonist used in dogs and cats to prevent and treat vomiting, including motion sickness and chemotherapy-induced emesis.
moxidectin: Moxidectin is a milbemycin endectocide used in livestock and companion animals against internal and external parasites, including intestinal worms.
propetamphos: Propetamphos is an organophosphate ectoparasiticide used against ticks, fleas and other external parasites.
selamectin: Selamectin is a topical avermectin used in dogs and cats against fleas, heartworm, ear mites and certain intestinal worms.
tilmicosin: Tilmicosin is a macrolide antibiotic used in cattle, sheep and pigs, primarily for the treatment of bovine and ovine respiratory disease.
1r-2s-2-3-4-difluorophenyl-cyclopropanam: (1R,2S)-2-(3,4-Difluorophenyl)cyclopropanamine (2R)-hydroxy(phenyl)ethanoate is a chiral cyclopropylamine salt used as a key intermediate in the synthesis of ticagrelor, an antiplatelet agent for acute coronary syndrome.
2-2-6-difluorobenzyl-ethoxycarbonyl-amin: This substituted thiophene carboxylic acid is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of relugolix, an oral GnRH antagonist used for prostate cancer, uterine fibroids and endometriosis.
2r-3r-3-2-5-difluorophenyl-3-hydroxy-2-m: (2R,3R)-3-(2,5-Difluorophenyl)-3-hydroxy-2-methyl-4-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)thiobutyramide is a chiral triazole intermediate in the synthesis of isavuconazonium sulfate, a broad-spectrum antifungal for invasive aspergillosis and mucormycosis.
2s-1-chloroacetyl-2-pyrrolidinecarbonitr: (2S)-1-(Chloroacetyl)-2-pyrrolidinecarbonitrile is a key intermediate in the synthesis of vildagliptin, a DPP-4 inhibitor used for type 2 diabetes.
3r-4s-3-2-bromoacetyl-4-ethyl-1-pyrrolid: This protected pyrrolidine is a chiral intermediate in the synthesis of upadacitinib, a JAK1 inhibitor used for rheumatoid arthritis, atopic dermatitis and other immune-mediated diseases.
r-5-2-2-dimethyl-4h-benzo-d-1-3-dioxin-6: (R)-5-(2,2-Dimethyl-4H-benzo[d][1,3]dioxin-6-yl)oxazolidin-2-one is a chiral oxazolidinone intermediate in the synthesis of vilanterol, a long-acting beta2 agonist used in COPD and asthma inhalers.
s-1-4-fluoro-1-methyl-1-h-indazol-5-yl-3: This indazole urea hydrochloride is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of orforglipron, an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist.
s-1-boc-3-hydroxypiperidine: (S)-1-Boc-3-hydroxypiperidine is a protected chiral piperidine used as a building block in the synthesis of ibrutinib, a BTK inhibitor for B-cell cancers.
1-2-iodoethyl-4-octylbenzene: 1-(2-Iodoethyl)-4-octylbenzene is an alkylating intermediate in the fingolimod synthesis route. Fingolimod is a sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator used for multiple sclerosis.
1-fluoronaphthalene: 1-Fluoronaphthalene is a fluorinated aromatic building block used in the synthesis of duloxetine, an SNRI antidepressant also used for neuropathic pain and anxiety.
1-phenyloctane: 1-Phenyloctane is the lipophilic side-chain starting material for the fingolimod synthesis route. Fingolimod is used for relapsing multiple sclerosis.
11-16-17-21-tetrahydroxypregna-1-4-diene: 11beta,16alpha,17,21-Tetrahydroxypregna-1,4-diene-3,20-dione is a steroid intermediate in the synthesis of budesonide, a corticosteroid used in asthma, allergic rhinitis and inflammatory bowel disease.
11-17-dihydroxy-6-methylpregna-1-4-diene: 11beta,17alpha-Dihydroxy-6alpha-methylpregna-1,4-diene-3,20-dione is a steroid intermediate in the synthesis of methylprednisolone, a systemic corticosteroid.
2-2-difluoropropionic-acid-ethyl-ester: Ethyl 2,2-difluoropropionate is a fluorinated ester building block used in pharmaceutical and agrochemical synthesis.
2-6-dichloro-4-methyl-3-trifluoromethyl-: 2,6-Dichloro-4-methyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine is a halogenated pyridine building block used in the synthesis of crop-protection and pharmaceutical compounds.
2-6-dioxopiperidine-3-ammonium-chloride: 2,6-Dioxopiperidine-3-ammonium chloride (3-aminopiperidine-2,6-dione hydrochloride) is the glutarimide core intermediate in the synthesis of lenalidomide, an immunomodulatory drug for multiple myeloma.
2-2-6-bromohexyl-oxy-ethoxy-methyl-1-3-d: This bromohexyl ether of dichlorobenzyl alcohol is a linker intermediate in the synthesis of vilanterol, the long-acting beta2 agonist component of COPD and asthma combination inhalers.
2-3ar-4s-6r-6as-6-amino-2-2-dimethyltetr: This cyclopentane amino alcohol L-tartrate is the chiral hydroxyl side-chain intermediate in the synthesis of ticagrelor, an antiplatelet agent for acute coronary syndrome.
2-2-3-2-7-chloro-2-quinolinyl-ethenylphe: This quinoline styryl alcohol is a key intermediate in the synthesis of montelukast, a leukotriene receptor antagonist used for asthma and allergic rhinitis.
2-2-amino-5-bromobenzoyl-pyridine: 2-(2-Amino-5-bromobenzoyl)pyridine is a benzophenone intermediate in the synthesis of remimazolam, an ultra-short-acting benzodiazepine used for procedural sedation and anaesthesia.
2-methylamino-pyridine-3-methanol: 2-(Methylamino)pyridine-3-methanol is a pyridine intermediate in the synthesis of isavuconazonium sulfate, a broad-spectrum antifungal prodrug.
2-1-mercaptomethyl-cyclopropyl-acetic-ac: 2-[1-(Mercaptomethyl)cyclopropyl]acetic acid is the thiol side-chain intermediate in the synthesis of montelukast, the leukotriene antagonist used for asthma.
2-bromo-thiophene: 2-Bromothiophene is a halogenated heterocycle used as a building block in the synthesis of clopidogrel, an antiplatelet agent.
2-bromopropionic-acid: 2-Bromopropionic acid is a brominated carboxylic acid building block used to introduce the 1-carboxyethyl group in pharmaceutical and agrochemical synthesis.
2-chlorophenothiazine: 2-Chlorophenothiazine is the tricyclic core intermediate for phenothiazine-class antipsychotic APIs such as chlorpromazine.
3-3-difluorocyclobutanecarboxylic-acid: 3,3-Difluorocyclobutanecarboxylic acid is a fluorinated small-ring building block used in medicinal chemistry.
3-1r-1-dimethylamino-ethyl-phenol: 3-[(1R)-1-(Dimethylamino)ethyl]phenol is the (R)-enantiomer chiral amine intermediate in the synthesis of rivastigmine, a cholinesterase inhibitor used for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease dementia.
3-1s-1-dimethylaminoethyl-phenol: 3-[(1S)-1-(Dimethylamino)ethyl]phenol is the (S)-enantiomer of the chiral amine intermediate on the rivastigmine route, supplied for synthesis, resolution and reference work.
3-1-dimethylamino-ethyl-phenol: 3-[1-(Dimethylamino)ethyl]phenol is the racemic chiral amine intermediate in the synthesis of rivastigmine, used where resolution to the (R)-enantiomer is carried out downstream.
4-4-difluorocyclohexanecarboxylic-acid: 4,4-Difluorocyclohexanecarboxylic acid is a fluorinated alicyclic building block used in medicinal chemistry.
4-6-dichloro-2-propylthiopyrimidine-5-am: 4,6-Dichloro-2-(propylthio)pyrimidin-5-amine is the pyrimidine core intermediate in the synthesis of ticagrelor, an antiplatelet agent for acute coronary syndrome.
4-2-bromoacetyl-benzonitrile: 4-(2-Bromoacetyl)benzonitrile is a bromoketone intermediate in the synthesis of fluvoxamine, an SSRI used for obsessive-compulsive disorder and depression.
4-chloro-1-2-methylpropyl-1h-imidazo-4-5: 4-Chloro-1-(2-methylpropyl)-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline is the chloro intermediate in the synthesis of imiquimod, an immune response modifier used topically for warts and certain skin cancers.
4-chloro-6-ethyl-5-fluoropyrimidine: 4-Chloro-6-ethyl-5-fluoropyrimidine is a halogenated pyrimidine intermediate in the synthesis of voriconazole, a broad-spectrum triazole antifungal.
4-hydroxy-1-methyl-7-phenoxy-3-isoquinol: Ethyl 4-hydroxy-1-methyl-7-phenoxyisoquinoline-3-carboxylate is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of roxadustat, a HIF prolyl hydroxylase inhibitor for anaemia of chronic kidney disease.
4-methoxy-alpha-methyl-n-phenylmethyl-be: 4-Methoxy-alpha-methyl-N-benzylbenzenemethanamine hydrochloride is a chiral-amine precursor in the synthesis of formoterol, a long-acting beta2 agonist for asthma and COPD.
4-octylphenethyl-methanesulfonate: 4-Octylphenethyl methanesulfonate is the mesylate alkylating intermediate in the fingolimod synthesis route. Fingolimod is used for relapsing multiple sclerosis.
4-phenoxybenzoic-acid: 4-Phenoxybenzoic acid is an aromatic acid intermediate in the synthesis of ibrutinib, a BTK inhibitor for B-cell cancers.
4-pyrimidinecarboxylic-acid-1-6-dihydro-: This protected aminodihydroxopyrimidine ester is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of raltegravir, an HIV integrase inhibitor.
5-2-fluorophenyl-1-h-pyrrole-3-carbonitr: 5-(2-Fluorophenyl)-1H-pyrrole-3-carbonitrile is the pyrrole core intermediate in the synthesis of vonoprazan, a potassium-competitive acid blocker for acid-related disease.
5-2r-2-oxiranyl-8-benzyloxy-2-1h-quinolo: 5-[(2R)-Oxiran-2-yl]-8-(benzyloxy)quinolin-2(1H)-one is the chiral epoxide intermediate in the synthesis of indacaterol, an ultra-long-acting beta2 agonist for COPD.
5-methoxy-1-4-trifluoromethyl-phenyl-1-p: 5-Methoxy-1-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1-pentanone is the ketone intermediate in the synthesis of fluvoxamine, an SSRI for obsessive-compulsive disorder and depression.
5h-pyrazolo-4-3-c-pyridine-5-carboxylic-: This protected aminopyrazolopyridine ester is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of orforglipron, an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist.
6-9-difluoro-16-methyl-11-17-21-trihydro: 6alpha,9alpha-Difluoro-16alpha-methyl-11beta,17alpha,21-trihydroxy-1,4-pregnadiene-3,20-dione is a fluorinated steroid intermediate in the synthesis of flumethasone, a potent corticosteroid.
7-keto-lithocholic-acid: 7-Ketolithocholic acid is the bile-acid intermediate in the synthesis of ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA), used for gallstones and cholestatic liver disease.
8dm-16-beta-methyl-epoxide: 8DM (dexamethasone 9,11-epoxide with the 16-beta methyl group) is the epoxide intermediate in the synthesis of dexamethasone, a corticosteroid.
acetoxy-empagliflozin: Acetoxy empagliflozin (peracetyl empagliflozin) is the protected glucoside intermediate in the synthesis of empagliflozin, an SGLT2 inhibitor for type 2 diabetes, heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
ampd: AMPD (2-amino-2-methyl-1,3-propanediol) is an aminodiol used as a buffer and as a building block in pharmaceutical and specialty chemical synthesis.
dapagliflozin-tetraacetate: Dapagliflozin tetraacetate (peracetyl dapagliflozin) is the protected glucoside intermediate in the synthesis of dapagliflozin, an SGLT2 inhibitor for type 2 diabetes, heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
db11: DB11 (betamethasone 9,11-epoxide) is the epoxide intermediate in the synthesis of betamethasone, a corticosteroid used in oral, injectable and topical products.
diethyl-2-acetamido-2-4-octylphenethyl-m: Diethyl 2-acetamido-2-(4-octylphenethyl)malonate is the malonate intermediate in the fingolimod synthesis route. Fingolimod is used for relapsing multiple sclerosis.
fmoc-d-thr-oh: Fmoc-D-Thr-OH is Fmoc-protected D-threonine, a building block for solid-phase peptide synthesis where a non-natural D-hydroxy amino acid is required.
methyl-2-bromomethyl-3-nitrobenzoate: Methyl 2-(bromomethyl)-3-nitrobenzoate is a bromomethyl benzoate intermediate in the synthesis of lenalidomide, an immunomodulatory drug for multiple myeloma.
n-5-acetyl-6-ethyl-2-3-dihydro-1h-inden-: This trifluoroacetyl-protected aminoindane is an intermediate in the synthesis of indacaterol, an ultra-long-acting beta2 agonist for COPD.
n-5-1r-2-bromo-1-hydroxyethyl-2-phenylme: This chiral bromohydrin carboxamide is an intermediate in the synthesis of formoterol, a long-acting beta2 agonist for asthma and COPD.
n-5-4-methylphenyl-sulfonyl-5h-pyrrolo-2: This tosyl-protected pyrrolopyrazine carbamate is an advanced intermediate in the synthesis of upadacitinib, a JAK1 inhibitor for immune-mediated diseases.
n-amino-3-azabicyclo-3-3-0-octan-hcl: N-Amino-3-azabicyclo[3.3.0]octane hydrochloride is the bicyclic hydrazine intermediate in the synthesis of gliclazide, a sulfonylurea for type 2 diabetes.
n-boc-3-pyrrolidinone: N-Boc-3-pyrrolidinone is a protected pyrrolidinone building block used in the synthesis of piperidine and pyrrolidine-containing drug candidates.
p-hydroxybenzoic-acid: p-Hydroxybenzoic acid is an aromatic hydroxy acid used as a synthesis building block and as the base material for paraben preservatives.
pyridine-3-sulfonyl-chloride-hydrochlori: Pyridine-3-sulfonyl chloride hydrochloride is the sulfonylating intermediate in the synthesis of vonoprazan, a potassium-competitive acid blocker.
r-3-amino-1-butanol: (R)-3-Amino-1-butanol is a chiral amino alcohol intermediate in the synthesis of dolutegravir, an HIV integrase inhibitor.
sitagliptin-base: Sitagliptin base is the free base of sitagliptin and the direct precursor of sitagliptin phosphate, a DPP-4 inhibitor for type 2 diabetes.
temed-n-n-n-n-tetramethylethylenediamine: TEMED (N,N,N',N'-tetramethylethylenediamine) is a tertiary diamine used as a polymerisation accelerator for polyacrylamide gels and as a basic catalyst in synthesis.
tert-butyl-4-formyl-5-methoxy-7-methyl-1: tert-Butyl 4-formyl-5-methoxy-7-methyl-1H-indole-1-carboxylate is a protected indole aldehyde intermediate in the synthesis of iptacopan, a complement factor B inhibitor for paroxysmal nocturnal haemoglobinuria.
tert-butyl-bromoacetate: tert-Butyl bromoacetate is an alkylating reagent used to install the tert-butyl ester protecting group in peptide and API synthesis.
tetrabutylammonium-bromide: Tetrabutylammonium bromide is a phase-transfer catalyst used to speed up reactions between aqueous and organic phases in API and intermediate synthesis.
triisopropylsilane: Triisopropylsilane is a silane reagent used as a cation scavenger and mild reducing agent during peptide deprotection and other synthesis steps.
z-d-thr-oh: Z-D-Thr-OH is Z-protected D-threonine, a building block for peptide synthesis where a non-natural D-hydroxy amino acid is required.
alpha-lipoic-acid: Alpha-lipoic acid is an antioxidant nutrient used in nutraceutical and supplement formulations.
argireline: Argireline (acetyl hexapeptide-8) is a cosmetic peptide used in anti-wrinkle skincare formulations.
beta-cyclodextrin: Beta-cyclodextrin is a cyclic oligosaccharide used to solubilise and stabilise poorly soluble actives and to mask odours and tastes in pharmaceutical and food formulations.
betadex-sulfobutyl-ether-sodium: Betadex sulfobutyl ether sodium is a modified cyclodextrin used to improve the solubility and stability of poorly water-soluble drugs in injectable and oral formulations.
branched-chain-amino-acids: Branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs - leucine, isoleucine and valine) are essential amino acids supplied as a blend for sports nutrition, clinical nutrition and infusion formulations.
coconut-oil: Coconut oil is a vegetable oil used as a base and carrier in nutraceutical softgels and food supplements.
coenzyme-q10: Coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone) is a fat-soluble antioxidant used in nutraceutical formulations.
copper-peptide: Copper peptide (GHK-Cu) is a copper-binding tripeptide used in cosmetic and dermatological formulations.
creatine-monohydrate: Creatine monohydrate is a sports-nutrition ingredient used in strength and performance supplement formulations.
d-threonine: D-threonine is the non-natural enantiomer of threonine, used as a chiral building block in peptide and pharmaceutical synthesis.
edetate-disodium: Edetate disodium (disodium EDTA) is a chelating agent used in formulations to bind metal ions and improve the stability of solutions, eye drops and topicals.
ergothioneine-egt: Ergothioneine (EGT) is a naturally occurring antioxidant amino acid used in nutraceutical and skincare formulations.
fish-oil: Fish oil is a source of omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA) used in softgel supplement formulations.
folic-acid: Folic acid (vitamin B9) is an essential vitamin used in supplements and fortified foods.
gamma-aminobutyric-acid: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is an inhibitory neurotransmitter used in nutraceutical formulations.
gamma-cyclodextrin: Gamma-cyclodextrin is an eight-unit cyclic oligosaccharide with a larger cavity than beta-cyclodextrin, used to solubilise bulky or poorly soluble actives.
glycine: Glycine is the simplest proteinogenic amino acid, used in infusion and nutrition formulations, as a sweet-tasting excipient, and as a synthesis raw material.
guanidinoacetic-acid: Guanidinoacetic acid is the direct metabolic precursor of creatine, used in sports nutrition and animal nutrition formulations.
hpmc-e-3-e-5-e-15: HPMC (hydroxypropyl methylcellulose) in the E-3, E-5 and E-15 viscosity grades is a cellulose ether used as a binder, film-coating polymer and matrix former in tablets and capsules.
hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin: Hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin is a highly water-soluble cyclodextrin derivative used to solubilise poorly soluble actives in pharmaceutical formulations.
inositol-nicotinate: Inositol nicotinate (inositol hexanicotinate) is a no-flush form of niacin used in supplement formulations.
isopropyl-myristate: Isopropyl myristate is an emollient ester used in topical and transdermal formulations to improve spreadability and skin penetration.
l-alanine: L-alanine is a non-essential amino acid used in infusion and clinical nutrition formulations and as a synthesis raw material.
l-arginine: L-arginine is a conditionally essential amino acid, a precursor of nitric oxide, used in nutrition products and infusion formulations.
l-arginine-l-aspartate: L-arginine L-aspartate is the aspartate salt of L-arginine, used in sports and clinical nutrition products.
l-carnitine-l-tartrate: L-carnitine L-tartrate is a stable salt of L-carnitine used in sports and weight-management supplement formulations.
l-carnosine: L-carnosine is a dipeptide of beta-alanine and histidine used in anti-ageing and sports nutrition formulations.
l-cysteine: L-cysteine is a sulphur-containing amino acid used in infusion and nutrition formulations, as a dough conditioner in food, and as a precursor of glutathione.
l-glutamic-acid: L-glutamic acid is a non-essential amino acid used in infusion and nutrition formulations and as a fermentation and synthesis raw material.
l-histidine: L-histidine is an essential amino acid used in infusion and clinical nutrition formulations and as a buffer component in biologic formulations.
l-leucine: L-leucine is an essential branched-chain amino acid with a central role in muscle protein synthesis, used in sports nutrition, clinical nutrition and infusion formulations.
l-lysine: L-lysine is an essential amino acid used in animal feed fortification, human nutrition products and infusion formulations.
l-methionine: L-methionine is an essential sulphur-containing amino acid used in feed fortification, nutrition products and infusion formulations.
l-phenylalanine: L-phenylalanine is an essential aromatic amino acid used in infusion and nutrition formulations and as a raw material for aspartame and peptide synthesis.
l-serine: L-serine is a non-essential amino acid used in infusion and cell-culture media formulations and as a synthesis raw material.
l-threonine: L-threonine is an essential amino acid used in feed fortification, nutrition products and infusion formulations.
l-tryptophan: L-tryptophan is an essential amino acid, a precursor of serotonin and melatonin, used in nutrition products and supplement formulations.
l-valine: L-valine is an essential branched-chain amino acid used in sports nutrition, clinical nutrition and infusion formulations.
luteolin: Luteolin is a flavonoid used in nutraceutical formulations.
melatonin: Melatonin is the body's sleep-timing hormone, used in supplement formulations for sleep support and jet lag.
microcrystalline-cellulose: Microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) is a purified cellulose used as a filler and dry binder in tablets and capsules.
n-acetyl-dl-l-leucine: N-acetyl-DL-leucine is an acetylated amino acid derivative used in vestibular (vertigo) research and formulations and as a synthesis intermediate.
natural-9-cis-b-carotene-dunaliella-sali: Natural beta-carotene from Dunaliella salina algae, rich in the 9-cis isomer, is used as a pro-vitamin A ingredient in supplements and as a natural colour.
peg-3350-4000-6000-20000: Polyethylene glycols in the 3350 to 20000 molecular-weight range are used as laxative bases, ointment and suppository bases, solvents and tablet lubricants.
phosphatidylcholine: Phosphatidylcholine is a phospholipid used as an emulsifier and liposome former in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations.
phosphatidylserine: Phosphatidylserine is a phospholipid used in nutraceutical formulations.
phytoene: Phytoene is a colourless carotenoid used in skincare and supplement formulations.
pvp-k-30-k-90: Povidone (PVP) in the K-30 and K-90 grades is a water-soluble polymer used as a tablet binder, solubiliser and film former in pharmaceutical formulations.
salcaprozate-sodium: Salcaprozate sodium (SNAC) is an absorption-enhancing excipient used to enable oral delivery of peptides, notably in oral semaglutide formulations.
sodium-hyaluronate: Sodium hyaluronate is the sodium salt of hyaluronic acid, used in eye drops, joint injections, skincare and wound-care formulations for its viscoelastic and hydrating properties.
sodium-starch-glycolate: Sodium starch glycolate is a superdisintegrant used in tablets and capsules to speed break-up and release of the active ingredient.
sodium-stearyl-fumarate: Sodium stearyl fumarate is a tablet and capsule lubricant used as an alternative to magnesium stearate.
spermidine-trihydrochloride: Spermidine trihydrochloride is a stable salt of the natural polyamine spermidine, used in nutraceutical formulations.
vitamin-b12: Vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) is an essential vitamin used in supplements, fortified foods and injectables for red blood cell formation, nerve function and energy metabolism.
vitamin-d3-40miu: Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) at 40 MIU/g is a concentrated grade used in feed and supplement formulations.
